title: Concept: Dependency resolved through the portal protocol
description: package.json declares a `portal:` dependency, a Yarn protocol that resolves a live directory, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The consumer reads the directory at run time, so the package contents are not frozen by the install and can change between builds.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
risk: The consumer reads the directory at run time, so the package contents are not frozen by the install and can change between builds.
